reason: Largest whole-cycle paired allocation fitting measured preparation plus 20% training allowance and reserved evaluation work. The initial 50-per-role target would exceed the total budget; reduction is shared and precedes scores.

limitations: Projection is not a completion guarantee; watchdog preserves recoverable checkpoints, and an incomplete pair will not be reported as the planned endpoint.
